E6_CONTRACT.input: same source-bound canonical host CSR; construct simple unweighted weak projection inside T_first; retain every canonical vertex including isolates
E6_CONTRACT.weights: original w16-v1 files remain input-bound; all E6 operators are explicitly unweighted
E6_CONTRACT.selection: all finite ES/Constraint rows; descending ES, ascending Constraint, canonical ID, after fixed round-to-even 1e-6 quantization; first min(32, finite vertices)
E6_CONTRACT.winner: maximum exact Wasserman-Faust closeness among actual selected vertices; fixed 1e-6 rounding then minimum canonical ID
E6_CONTRACT.closeness: 32 exact sources, not a full all-vertex closeness ranking; r^2/((n-1)*sum_distance), zero for r=0
E6_CONTRACT.complete: all ES and Constraint values, candidate IDs, every candidate closeness value, winner, full BFS distances and full canonical WCC partition on host
E6_CONTRACT.timing: T_first starts with common host CSR ready and includes weak projection, imports, graph formats, uploads, all five calls, host materialization, both dependent selections; T_ready retains graph state after one full warmup; close recorded separately
E6_CONTRACT.ablation: two extension groups structural=(ES,Constraint) and closeness independently native/external; both 2x2 panels share native P1 none control; external=igraph CPU or unchanged cuGraph/CuPy GPU composite; BFS/WCC stay EGGPU in all four 2x2 arms; legacy CPU bfs/wcc single-group fallbacks remain separate supplementary analyses; no precomputed outputs or omitted functions
E6_CONTRACT.mg: whole graph replicated on each GPU; ego-vertex shards for structural metrics and selected-source shards for closeness; BFS/WCC on logical GPU0; not partitioned capacity scaling
E6_CONTRACT.task_origin: controlled structural screening workflow, not an observed production trace
